video_description: A group of people are seated around a table with a checkered tablecloth in a room featuring a whiteboard.
While gesturing, <voice_1170> asks if the plan involves eating BBQ and mixing drinks between 5 and 6 PM.
A man in a white shirt approaches the table and places a potted plant on it.
<voice_1844> mentions 'last time' and adds that they will not follow the plan strictly.
<voice_1846> concludes by proposing a 5 to 6 PM time interval.
The camera pans away to reveal a projector screen and the general layout of the room.
A man in a pink shirt stands up and moves towards the window area.
The group continues their discussion while seated around the table.
high_level_conclusions: The participants are coordinating a schedule for an evening social gathering involving food and drinks.
They decided to allow some flexibility regarding the strict timing of the event.
The proposed time slot for the activity is between 5 PM and 6 PM.
